description: Pay an invoice from the account CREDIT BALANCE (not a card). Get the id from `impreza_list_invoices`. If the balance does not cover it the call fails with INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE — top up with `impreza_topup`, wait for the crypto payment to confirm, then call this again. This is the step that turns a domain registration or an upgrade into an active service.
name: impreza_pay_invoice
